interface.label: Compute Budget Program
interface.encoding: 1-byte tag + bare LE integer arg (runtime to_instruction! macro: data[0] = tag, then $num.to_le_bytes())
interface.runtime: anza-xyz/agave@master (read 2026-10-31), compute-budget-instruction: borsh try_from_slice_unchecked; unclaimed tag or Unused(0) => InvalidInstructionData
interface.measured: 2026-10-31 mainnet harvest: 1.348 payloads, tags {2: 651, 3: 550, 4: 147}; tags 0 and 1 not observed on live mainnet — consistent with the runtime reject rule. 27 payloads carry trailing bytes after the declared arg; chain adjudication (9 fetched, byte-identical to the harvest) shows the runtime tolerates them (borsh try_from_slice_unchecked ignores the remainder), and every one sat in a transaction that failed at a LATER instruction
interface.divergence: @solana/web3.js@1.98.4 still ENCODES legacy requestUnits as tag 0 + (u32,u32) — the pre-2023 wire shape the runtime no longer parses; this module refuses tag 0 instead of copying the SDK
